finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created: reference **RD-1015**, title **"fwrd67-n1 RD Bench Ticket"**, customer "Bench Test Co", initial status **Draft**. (The create dialog had only two fields: Title* and Customer.)

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part **"fwrd67-n1 RD Part A"** with cost $100.00 and markup 25% → app-computed price **$125.00** (100 × 1.25).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part **"fwrd67-n1 RD Part B"** with cost $200.00 and markup 25% → app-computed price **$250.00** (200 × 1.25). Ticket total after both parts: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup still 25%) → recomputed price **$187.50** (150 × 1.25). Ticket total rose to $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Status is **Ready**. The precondition discovered: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. Clicking "Mark Ready" initially failed with the verbatim alert:
> "Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd67-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd67-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"

What was required to satisfy it: editing each part to set a Supplier ("Acme Supply" on both), leaving cost/markup unchanged. After that, "Mark Ready" succeeded — the status line read "Status Ready" and the button set changed to Mark Draft / Mark Closed. (Note: status is not a dropdown; transitions are driven by action buttons.)

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted (each via a Confirm dialog → "Delete part"); the parts table then showed only "No parts on this ticket yet." and the list view reports **0 parts** for RD-1015. The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket" (no confirmation prompt; button became "Unarchive ticket"). Verified in the tickets list: RD-1015 does **not** appear in the default (active) list — searching "fwrd67-n1" with default filters returns "No tickets match the current filters." It only appears when the "Show archived" checkbox is ticked, as: `RD-1015 | fwrd67-n1 RD Bench Ticket [Archived] | Bench Test Co | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-17`. No other ticket contains "fwrd67-n1", so nothing created by this run remains active.
